But how does it actually work?
Pool opens on the cheapest listed target NFT. Users deposit ETH into the pool.
The NFT is acquired and immediately listed at a higher price.
The pool reopens on the next cheapest listing. The cycle continues.
When the market climbs, it sells. 100% back + markup.
100% of your ETH deposit in that pool is returned — plus the markup value
Sale proceeds split back across every wallet in the pool, pro rata, in ETH.
We don't need the market to climb.
Pools buy from each other, releasing capital and profit to earlier pools. So even with no market at all, the wheel keeps turning.
This is the spinwheel — and it works even if the market is standing still. In effect, we're capturing value from the collection's floor price.
